cards.text: It's DONE, friend. Solomon, king of Israel, has finished all the work on the house of the LORD. I can't finish a batch without sneaking three cookies, and this man finished a TEMPLE.

cards.question: Next, Solomon brings in the silver, the gold and all the furnishings his father David had dedicated. Where does he put them?

answers.text: In the treasuries of God's house
In the storerooms of his palace

cards.text: Then Solomon calls in everybody who's anybody to Jerusalem: the elders of Israel, all the tribal heads and family leaders. He needs them to bring something holy up from Zion, the City of David.

cards.question: Solomon gathers the elders to bring up the ___ of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.

cards.text: All the men of Israel come together to the king at the feast in the seventh month. A group chat of four people can take two WEEKS to pick a day, and Solomon gets all the men of Israel in one place.
All the elders of Israel have arrived, and it's time to move the ark. Long before this, the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry it (Deuteronomy 10:8).

cards.question: With all the elders gathered, King Solomon takes up the ark himself.

cards.text: The Levitical priests carry the ark up, and with it comes the Tent of Meeting and all its sacred furnishings.

cards.question: Right there before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation sacrifice so many sheep and oxen that they can't be ___.

cards.text: So many nobody could count them, and I lose count of chocolate chips at about forty, so I'd have been NO help. Then the priests carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD into the temple, to its place.

cards.question: The priests set the ark of the covenant in its place. Where in the temple is that?

answers.text: The main hall by the lampstands

cards.text: There the ark rests beneath the wings of the cherubim, which spread over the ark and its poles. The poles are long enough that their ends show from in front of the inner sanctuary but not from outside the Holy Place, and they were still there when this was written.

cards.question: Now, the ark of the covenant itself. What's inside it?
At Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt, the two tablets were placed in the ark by ___.

cards.text: Every priest who's there has consecrated himself, whatever his division. Then the priests come out of the Holy Place.

The Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives, stand on the east side of the altar in fine linen with cymbals, harps and lyres, and 120 priests with trumpets join them. Friend, the loudest music my old junk drawer ever had was the dead batteries rattling when somebody slammed it shut.

cards.question: The trumpeters and singers join together to praise and thank the LORD. How do they sound?

cards.text: You know when an office sings happy birthday and half the room is on "dear" while the other half is still on "happy"? These folks lift their voices with trumpets, cymbals and instruments in praise to the LORD: "For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever."

cards.question: The singers and trumpeters praise the LORD. Then the temple, the house of the LORD, is filled with something. What is it?
Because of the cloud filling the temple, the priests can't stand there to minister.
The priests can't stand there to minister, because the ___ of the LORD filled the house of God.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this one down for now, friend. Keep that apron on, because this story isn't done.
